Name: Sold Item Dialogue
Author: sunshineydays
Description:
I think it's fun to have the NPCs comment about the items you sell in-shop.

Changed to be a bit nicer and complimentary of the farmer's efforts, and indicates that Pierre is promoting your produce/items/farm rather than taking credit for the gold-star items or not even mentioning where the item is from.

Also now included, Short Sold Item Dialogue! Complimentary dialogue, but only a single text box long. Not as immersive or specific, but perhaps a happy medium between no dialogue and the regular dialogue. Change to "Short" in the Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]Future Goals:
[/b][list]
[*]dialogue dependent on friendship level
[/list]
(Modified existing lines for items you sell to Pierre and Willy)

(This is my first mod, so there may be bugs. Please let me know if you find something off and I'll do my best to fix it!)
